data.heading: Bring the team. We’ll bring the questions.
body: First-time teams are every bit as welcome as the regulars. You do not need to be a quiz expert — just bring a team willing to have a go.
Come down early, grab some food and a drink, then settle in before the first question at 7pm. The full menu is available from 4pm to 9pm.

data.body: Book ahead to secure your table, then all you need to do is round up the team.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
